title: #health-log-mum — Mum daily health logging workflow (MASTER)
body:
Single source-of-truth card for Mum's daily health logging. Implements the elder-health-daily-logging skill. NOT currently a live board task — this card is the durable master reference.

WORKFLOW:
1. Receive daily health report (morning/midday/evening) from nurse Stephanie via Telegram (Vault/family/mum/health/).

3. Save markdown to Vault/family/mum/health/YYYY-MM-DD_<period>_report.md (period mapping: afternoon->midday).
4. Save any photos with matching date prefix; embed via relative path.
5. Run scripts/verify_daily_report.py to confirm date/image consistency.
6. Produce the 'MUM EVENING LOG' per AGENTS.md (no conversational filler).

KEY MEDS: Furosemide 20mg. Watch BP (prior spike 178/87 on 31/7/26, resolved).

title: Retrieve and review supplier dashboard file prior to outreach
body:
**Goal**
Locate, retrieve, and review the latest supplier dashboard file to confirm data accuracy and identify key context for upcoming supplier outreach.

**Approach**
- Search shared team drives, project management platforms, and email archives for the most recent version of the supplier dashboard file.
- Validate the retrieved file is the correct up-to-date version by checking its last modified timestamp and version history notes.
- Review dashboard contents to confirm supplier performance metrics, contact details, and pending action items are accurate.
- Document any identified discrepancies or missing data for follow-up prior to outreach.

**Acceptance criteria**
- [ ] The latest correct version of the supplier dashboard file is successfully retrieved and accessible.
- [ ] All key supplier metrics, contact information, and pending action items in the dashboard are confirmed as accurate.
- [ ] Any identified discrepancies or missing data are documented and flagged for resolution by the relevant team.
- [ ] A concise summary of review findings is prepared to inform upcoming supplier outreach activities.

**Out of scope**
- Modifying or updating the supplier dashboard file itself.
- Conducting actual supplier outreach or follow-up communications.
- Resolving identified discrepancies (only flagging for relevant stakeholders).
